protocol.milestone: Qdrant-source distribution-based score fusion quality screen
protocol.mechanism: Per lane Welford sample variance; normalize by mean +/-3 sample standard deviations; empty lane empty; single or constant lane 0.5; sum scores of shared chunk IDs; equal lane weights 1. No clipping, no weight or sigma sweep.
protocol.adaptations: Python float64 arithmetic rather than Rust f32; deterministic fusion ties use chunk_id ascending. Neural rerank ties use fusion score descending then chunk_id ascending as existing production.
protocol.screen_policy: All 809 official SciFact train queries. Reuse every actual full-union BGE cross-encoder score once for quality-only candidate replay. Strictly require all dense/sparse union IDs scored and source mappings consistent. No cached latency claim; changed batch packing can require a later actual run.
protocol.primary: One nDCG@10 comparison; 10000 paired bootstrap over shared-positive-document connected components, 95% interval
protocol.secondary: Exploratory Recall@5/20 and MRR@10; fusion candidate source-document coverage
protocol.decision: Only a passing screen qualifies for real paired retrieval and latency evaluation; otherwise preserve baseline and close this mechanism without parameter tuning
protocol.limits: Repeated DEV labels and reuse of earlier measured candidate scores make this exploratory screening, not independent confirmation or a platform Formal Experiment. No generated-answer claim, no test or NFCorpus label access, no production default change.

scope: Exploratory cached quality screening; no latency claim

retrieval_identity.text_policy: stripped title + two newlines + stripped abstract

protocol.milestone: RAG fusion budget separation and source diversity
protocol.dataset: BEIR SciFact, full 5183-document corpus, existing 9189 production chunks
protocol.dev: All 809 official train queries; independent cross-encoder candidate score reuse for quality screening only
protocol.confirmation: All 300 official test queries, previously exposed; regression only, not a fresh blind holdout

selection_rule.choice: Eligible arms within 0.002 of best nDCG@10: prefer smaller rerank budget, then higher nDCG@10; otherwise baseline

protocol.scoring: Document dedup before metric cutoffs, using the fixed final 20 raw chunks; raw first-five-chunk gold availability is separately named
protocol.primary: nDCG@10: four paired comparisons vs baseline, 10000 gold-overlap cluster bootstrap, 98.75% Bonferroni intervals
protocol.secondary: Recall@5/10/20 and MRR@5/10; exploratory 95% paired cluster intervals
protocol.latency: Actual five-arm per-query randomized interleaving, shared warm models, concurrency 1; omit every arm of first query; mean/p50/p95 and paired cluster mean CI
protocol.runtime: Existing offline BGE-M3 dense, tokenizer log-TF plus Qdrant IDF sparse, BGE reranker-v2-m3; CUDA batch8; snapshot SQL join
protocol.limits: Retrieval only, no answer generation or ContextBudgetPolicy admission measurement, no API generation charges or fabricated token/dollar cost
protocol.compatibility: New budgets and soft source quota opt-in; old snapshots and default retrieval behavior preserved

source_metadata.scope: retrieval only; test already exposed; not a platform Formal Experiment

metric_projection: First20 raw chunks, deduplicate source documents before metric ranks

_publication.policy: case text, source corpus, requests, credentials and per-case objects omitted
